item.title: How to make the most of the quiet period between Christmas and New Year
item.description: Make the most of these last days of the year to slow down, reflect, and reconnect with God.

item.title: US carries out strikes on Islamic State in Nigeria over violence against Christians
item.description: The US military has conducted airstrikes against Islamic State (IS) militants in Nigeria over the violent "targeting" of Christians.

item.title: Over £900,000 awarded to help UK churches stay open amid growing funding pressures
item.description: Hundreds of churches across the UK are receiving vital financial support to remain open and safe, as rising repair costs and shrinking funding streams place historic buildings under increasing strain.

item.title: US criticises prosecution of pro-life campaigner over silent prayer near abortion clinic
item.description: The US State Department has said it is closely monitoring the prosecution of a Christian woman who prayed silently in an abortion clinic buffer zone.

item.description: The King should be aware that his beloved doctrine of ‘diversity’ is now tearing his kingdom apart.

item.title: Two hundred years of the Brethren: who are they and what do they believe?
item.description: This year marks 200 years since the founding of the Brethren movement - one of several renewal movements to emerge from 1800 onwards.

item.title: Missionary turned soldier in Ukraine balances faith with harsh frontline realities
item.description: A former missionary who is now serving as a soldier in the Ukrainian army has spoken about the realities of faith for a man tasked with killing in defence of his country.

item.title: Anglican Mainstream sees monthly growth despite web hosting suspension
item.description: Conservative Christian website, Anglican Mainstream, was surprised to see visitor numbers rise after being forced to relocate its website hosting after GoDaddy closed its account.

item.title: What if the Good Shepherd is closer than you think?
item.description: Pastoral care is not a task reserved for a handful of gifted individuals; it is the life of Christ, quietly at work inside ordinary believers.
